summary: Adds configurable container tinting, marker styling, and Mod Hub controls for lootable containers.
details: Container Highlight now exposes a configurable highlight key, tint color, marker text, marker icon, and marker color through Mod Hub.
Marker labels render with a contrasting larger text layer behind them so the text stays readable over bright or noisy backgrounds.
Advanced Mod Hub settings include debug logging plus the probe and render trace actions used for troubleshooting.
The old box-style screen highlight toggle is no longer surfaced in Mod Hub because it did not produce a meaningful difference in practice.
